title: MCP Server
description: Connect an AI client such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Cursor to this workspace. The client can then read and edit the data your access token allows — and nothing else.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: Point your MCP client at this URL. One endpoint covers every space and base your token can reach.

token.title: Access token
token.description: MCP clients authenticate with a personal access token. Give it only the scopes the tools you plan to use require.
token.hint: The token is shown once, when you create it. Store it in your client configuration straight away.

catalogue.title: Available tools
catalogue.description: What a connected client can do. Each tool is checked against your token's scopes and your own permissions on every call.
catalogue.writesDisabled: Writes are disabled on this instance (MCP_READONLY), so only read tools are listed.

limits.title: Limits
limits.maxDelete: At most {{count}} records deleted per call

safety.title: What a client cannot do
safety.description: Fields and tables cannot be deleted, and field types cannot be converted, through MCP — those operations are irreversible. Deleted records and views go to the table trash and can be restored.
safety.learnMore: Deleted records can be restored from the table Trash panel.
